plan.summary: Email sign-in in three tasks: auth module, cookie sessions, form and tests.
plan.goal: Let users sign in with email and password.

tasks.title: Auth module
tasks.description: Add an auth module that checks email and password.

items: Auth lives in its own module.
Passwords are hashed with a slow hash.

tasks.title: Cookie sessions
tasks.description: Keep the session in a signed cookie.

items: The cookie is HttpOnly and Secure.
The form works from the keyboard alone.

tasks.title: Tests
tasks.description: Cover sign-in and sessions with tests.

items: Each behaviour has a test that fails without it.

alternatives.rejectedBecause: OAuth setup and a third-party dependency.

decisions.title: Session length
decisions.chosen: A week, with sign out everywhere
decisions.why: A week, with sign out everywhere.
